question.problem:
Given the figure below, find the value of $x.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14173512/assets/8b89eec86675b2bebfda74ecf1da8e0b7980e5de6d3a52de84e93e64a4a62068.png)
question.worked_solution:
The two angles marked in the diagram are vertical. 
Since vertical angles are congruent, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}2x+{12}^{∘} & ={54}^{∘} \\ 2x & ={42}^{∘} \\ x & ={21}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$
